context: Tests whether the agent produces an installable voice skill: valid frontmatter, a narrowly scoped description, and the passages and anti-examples placed in references files that SKILL.md links to.

checklist.name: SKILL.md with valid frontmatter
checklist.description: small-complaints/SKILL.md exists and begins with YAML frontmatter containing a lowercase hyphenated name field and a description field.

checklist.name: Narrow description
checklist.description: The description names the narrow context the voice is for, such as the humor column, its newspaper lifestyle section, or its general readers, and says when to use it. A description that would fire on any writing request scores zero.

checklist.name: Characteristics and quick rules in SKILL.md
checklist.description: SKILL.md itself holds the voice characteristics, each with evidence from the samples, and a short list of quick-reference dos and don'ts.

checklist.name: Passages in a references file
checklist.description: Representative passages from the samples are in one or more files under small-complaints/references/, not in SKILL.md.

checklist.name: Anti-examples in a references file
checklist.description: Anti-examples, written passages that break the voice with a reason for each, are in one or more files under small-complaints/references/, not in SKILL.md.

checklist.name: SKILL.md links and says when to read
checklist.description: SKILL.md links to each references file by relative path and says when to read it, for example before drafting or when checking a draft.

checklist.name: Passages are verbatim
checklist.description: The representative passages appear word for word in the sample files.
